metadata.description: Self-hosted best-practice plugins: UI/UX stacks, frameworks, databases, architecture, design patterns, testing, security, API design, dev environments, and the taskmaster clarification-to-execution workflow suite.

plugins.name: ui-ux
plugins.description: UI/UX best practices with per-stack skills: shadcn/ui, ReUI, Aceternity UI, Astryx, Material UI, Tailwind, plus a library-agnostic component-libraries skill (headless and styled React libraries, owned-code vs dependency rules, a per-library map) — plus a design-tokens skill (spacing/type/radius/elevation/motion scales + semantic color tiering), a theming-system skill, theme creation with a live colour preview, a /ui-ux:build entry point, a WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audit (/ui-ux:audit, the a11y-audit skill, and an a11y-engineer worker that applies the fix list with native semantics over ARIA patches), and ui-ux-reviewer + ui-ux-engineer agents.

plugins.name: craft-layer
plugins.description: Create unique, animated, informative web apps (CRM, SaaS, landing pages) across React, Tailwind, Vue, Next, Nuxt, and Laravel. /craft-layer:craft runs the studio pipeline end to end — creative direction, design research, asset sourcing with a licence gate, theming and component build via ui-ux, and a tiered motion system (Framer, anime.js, Three.js/R3F, Lottie/Rive, sprites) with reduced-motion and reduced-bundle fallbacks. /craft-layer:sections guides per-section decisions, /craft-layer:audit reviews a shipped tree, and ultra-craft escalates a run with live web research and a red-team of the result. Ships the Three.js/R3F skill (WebGPU-first, TSL, asset pipelines, disposal) behind /craft-layer:review. Requires ui-ux, which carries the WCAG audit.

plugins.name: laravel
plugins.description: Laravel best practices: Eloquent N+1 prevention, form requests, service layer, queues, policies, a per-version leverage map (Laravel 11/12/13), mass-assignment security — and the Inertia.js skill (v1/v2/v3, Vue/React/Svelte adapters: partial reloads, deferred props, useForm, shared data, SSR) it pairs with, loaded by the code-review fan-in when the manifests show it — plus the backend-engineer worker (PHP/Laravel) that applies the review's fixes.

plugins.name: code-architecture
plugins.description: Engineering process: plan-before-code, YAGNI, SOLID principles applied with judgment, task orchestration, work verification — enforced by a blocking Stop hook that refuses a completion claim when files were edited but nothing ran afterward — low-cognitive-load code, KISS/DRY simplicity principles. Owns structure at both levels: code (units, interfaces, file placement) and system (service boundaries on data ownership, scaling paths, cache placement, sync vs async integration, domain modeling) via the system-design and domain-modeling skills and the system-architect worker.

plugins.name: taskmaster
plugins.description: Idea-to-execution clarification: brainstorm fuzzy ideas into approved designs, grill requirements until zero ambiguity, deliberate the implementation approach with a blind four-persona round (via the approaches plugin when installed; inline 2-3 approaches otherwise), decide visual choices with mockups, validate whole experiences with an interactive clickable demo, then emit milestone-grouped single-prompt task cards. Outputs live under taskmaster-docs/ (no collision with a project's own docs/).

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Git workflow discipline: isolated worktrees for feature work, a structured finish protocol for development branches (verify, present options, merge/PR/park, clean up), and review-exchange rigor — what to include when requesting review, and technical verification before implementing received feedback. Ships a PreToolUse guard that refuses any commit, merge, tag or PR carrying a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer or a Generated-with-Claude-Code line. Includes /git-workflow:finish.

plugins.name: debugging
plugins.description: Systematic debugging: root cause before any fix — reproduce first, read the actual error, isolate with hypothesis tests and bisection, one change at a time, verify against the original symptom; escalation rule after three failed fixes. Ships a delegatable debugger agent for handing off the long reproduce-bisect investigation. Includes /debugging:debug.

plugins.name: task-runner
plugins.description: Disciplined task execution: one task at a time, scope locked to the task, bounded verify-fix inner loop per task, no drift, no unbounded outer loop. Completion means every check passed with evidence. Ships the shared task-executor agent — the delegatable 'apply the fixes' sink every review routes to — a PostToolUse scope-lock tripwire, parallel-planning (/task-runner:plan), and the subagent discipline (the orchestration plugin was merged in on 2026-09-14): delegation contracts (self-contained prompts, evidence-backed compressed returns, model/effort tiering, the role-floor registry), verification panels (refuter voting, judge panels, completeness critic), scripts/dispatch-lint.sh, and the ultra-assess boost hook.

plugins.name: overseer
plugins.description: A program-level product owner for long, multi-session, multi-branch builds. /overseer:start "Build a CRM that manages clients" inventories the project and every installed plugin (user, project, local scope), asks one clarifying round, writes a milestone roadmap, then delivers each milestone on its own branch by briefing the taskmaster pipeline and task-runner execution with skill-pinned dispatch prompts. An accept script refuses to close a milestone until the app was driven in a real browser at three widths with a clean console — a green suite alone does not count. State under .claude/overseer/ lets /overseer:resume continue in a fresh session; a SessionStart hook announces it.

plugins.name: stack-scan
plugins.description: Know what is installed, keep it healthy, find what to add. /stack-scan:report inventories manifests, lockfiles (composer, npm/yarn/pnpm/bun), runtimes and docker images into a required-vs-installed table with drift, missing locks and EOL majors flagged. /stack-scan:audit runs the composer/npm vulnerability, outdated and licence checks (package-hygiene) — report-only. /stack-scan:suggest reads the same manifests and suggests every marketplace plugin in three tiers with cited evidence (--yes auto-installs tiers 1-2, --full the whole stack-relevant set after one confirm, --persist/--global set scope); --skills searches skills.sh for third-party skills instead — provenance, preview, explicit picks only. Add-at-all is approaches' build-vs-buy.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Testing best practices: test pyramid and what to actually test, Pest/PHPUnit and Vitest/Jest idioms, Playwright/Dusk e2e discipline, factories and fixtures, mocking boundaries, flaky-test causes, coverage traps — plus the TDD workflow (red-green-refactor, red-green regression proof for bug fixes). Includes /testing:review, /testing:flake-hunt and a test-engineer worker agent.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security for web apps: OWASP-aligned code review (injection, XSS, CSRF, authz vs authn, mass assignment, uploads, secrets, dependency audit) mapped to PHP/Laravel and JS/Vue, PLUS design-phase threat-modeling (STRIDE, trust boundaries), a data-privacy (GDPR/CCPA) regulatory lens, and an api-auth lens (token model, OAuth2+PKCE, scopes). Includes /security:review and a security-engineer worker agent.

plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: APIs in both directions: design your own (resource naming, status-code discipline, pagination/filtering/sorting, versioning, RFC 9457 errors, idempotency, Laravel API Resources, plus a graphql-grpc skill for non-REST surfaces; /api-design:review and spec-first /api-design:scaffold) and consume others' honestly — verify current official API/SDK docs before writing integration code (UserPromptSubmit reminder + /api-design:check, the api-docs-first skill) and keep your own docs true after a change with the docs-upkeep drift scan: README claims, changelog gaps, stale examples, dead links (/api-design:drift).

plugins.name: web-dev
plugins.description: Web development in one plugin: a web-developer worker (routing, REST/API integration, forms, state, SSR/CSR), an opus-floored frontend-reviewer for component and view logic, and three version-pinned stack skills — Next.js (App Router boundaries, opt-in caching, server actions, 14→16), React Native (lists, navigation, native-driver animation, Expo inversions), Vite (VITE_ env security, chunking, base, proxy, 5→8) — loaded by the code-review fan-in from the lockfile. Inertia and Laravel stay in their own plugins; plain JS/TS needs no skill.

plugins.name: design-studio
plugins.description: Design in the browser, decide with real components, source from registries. /design-studio:init opens a design session — chat, select, drag, resize, edit text and pick colours on HTML prototypes or your running dev server, with this Claude Code session applying every gesture to real files and live-reloading; skins show one wireframe in the feel of shadcn, Bootstrap, MUI or Astryx (lookalikes, never the library); /design-studio:export writes tokens, pages and a brief. /design-studio:preview renders 2-3 variants with the project's OWN components on its dev server, consent-gated, cleaned up after. Two MCP servers read the Aceternity, shadcn, Magic UI and ReUI registries live, never from memory.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Infrastructure in one plugin: CI/CD ordering, container/image hygiene, Kubernetes limits and probes, deploy strategy with rollback, and secrets handling (devops-practices); Dockerfile and compose discipline (docker-best-practices); and local dev environments generated from evidence — manifests, lockfiles, .env DSNs, CI images — via /devops:init (compose-init). One /devops:review loads the Docker skill when a Dockerfile or compose file is in scope, backed by a PreToolUse guard on workflow files and a devops-engineer worker + devops-reviewer pair. Owns infra-layer observability wiring; defers in-code instrumentation to resilience's observability skill.

plugins.name: database
plugins.description: Relational databases in one plugin: the engine-agnostic sql-best-practices skill (sargable predicates, joins, indexes, NULL logic, transactions, keyset pagination, safe migrations, parameterization), the mariadb-best-practices dialect skill (10.6+ divergences, RETURNING, sequences, system-versioned tables, Galera) that the code-review fan-in loads only when the detected engine is MariaDB, a database-engineer worker that applies schema, migration, indexing and pooling work, and a PreToolUse guard that asks before a destructive statement (DROP/TRUNCATE/unqualified DELETE-UPDATE) lands.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic code review: correctness bugs, code smells, convention drift on any diff or PR — severity-sorted one-line findings — plus comment discipline: every fact routed to the artifact that cannot lie about it, comments spent only on why-not-the-obvious, external constraints, intentional silence and contract facts (default: no comment; write-time hooks warn, and deny the three strictest patterns plus any whole file over a 0.4:1 comment ceiling, once per file per session; /code-review:comment-review). Defers structure/YAGNI to code-architecture, security depth to security, stack idioms to the per-framework review plugins. Includes /code-review:review, a code-reviewer agent, the code-smells, reuse-hygiene and comment-discipline skills. The fan-in for overlapping review surfaces: loads every installed matching stack skill in one pass.

plugins.name: approaches
plugins.description: Solution-approach deliberation before non-trivial implementation: 2-3 structurally different approaches with trade-offs and a kill-trigger, a strategy catalog mapped to the risk each beats, a four-persona blind opinion round for refactor-shaped tasks — plus the merged pre-code disciplines: build-vs-buy checks, S/M/L/XL estimation, rollout planning, design-pattern selection, and /approaches:consult, a blind stronger-model second opinion when a session is stuck or about to do something irreversible (fresh-take merged in). Includes /approaches:compare, /approaches:opinions, /approaches:build-vs-buy, /approaches:size, /approaches:rollout, /approaches:pattern.

plugins.name: hindsight
plugins.description: Cross-session self-improvement loop: mines session transcripts for recurring friction and proposes CLAUDE.md rules, skill/plugin ideas, and failed-approach warnings — applied only on approval.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: A committed, Obsidian-style codebase map for a project: brain/INDEX.md indexes areas, key files, and notable classes/entrypoints so a fresh Claude session starts oriented. A SessionStart hook injects the compact map (with a staleness hint when it lags HEAD); /brain reads it and /brain index builds/refreshes it. Builds the map only — it never annotates code, and nothing outside brain/ is ever modified.

plugins.name: resilience
plugins.description: Runtime quality in one plugin — does it stay up, can you see it, is it fast. Failure-mode design for integration points (timeouts, retries with backoff and idempotency, circuit breaking, graceful degradation, delivery semantics) with the merged error-handling and concurrency disciplines and the event-driven skill (brokers, outbox, sagas, DLQ, consumer idempotency); application observability (structured logs with correlation IDs, RED/USE metrics without cardinality bombs, trace propagation, honest health checks); and measure-first performance (N+1, payload, bundle, Core Web Vitals, cache correctness, percentile load tests). One audit, /resilience:review, over all six rubrics or one of them via --concern, and two workers, observability-engineer and performance-engineer, that apply only what a measurement or a finding proves.

plugins.name: candor
plugins.description: Candour as a mechanism, not a pep talk. One blocking Stop gate, four clauses a script can prove: a file:line citation resolving to no file or past its end; a position retracted after bare pushback with no tool call in between; a completion claim after edits with nothing executed since; a registered task-runner run stopping without its recorded gate pass. Flattery, apologies and defensive phrasing are counted by /candor:check and blocked by nothing, on purpose. Plus the terse reply mode (/candor:level lite|full|ultra|off): chat-message brevity as a shape contract — prose-line budgets and a fixed report skeleton, never less work in the turn.

plugins.name: frontend-suite
plugins.description: Meta-bundle: the frontend stack category in one install — UI/UX stacks, web-dev (Next.js, React Native, Vite skills, the generalist worker and the opus-floored frontend-reviewer), the WCAG audit inside ui-ux, skill auto-routing (skill-router), and code-review (the review fan-in that loads those skills for whatever the diff touches, plus comment discipline: no-comment default, write-time denies for restatement, commented-out code, signature-repeating docblocks and files over the comment ceiling). Inertia lives in the laravel plugin (install by name). The creative-build studio — craft-layer (with its Three.js skill) and design-studio — moved to craft-suite, so ordinary frontend app work does not pay the studio's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /frontend-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.

plugins.name: core-suite
plugins.description: Meta-bundle: the user-scope baseline — the plugins worth enabling once, globally, and keeping on in every repo: secret-scanning's write-time block, candor's four-clause Stop gate and dormant terse mode, code-review's fan-in review with comment discipline, git-workflow's branch finish, hindsight's friction mining, skill-router's file-aware routing, and stack-scan's report, audit and project-tier scout. Replaces always-on-suite and quality-suite (2026-09-14). Membership rule: project-agnostic, safe as a permanent fixture, adds no interruption you did not ask for — why command-guard's ask tier is not here. Uninstall with /core-suite:uninstall. 200k windows: read the README first.

plugins.name: workflow-suite
plugins.description: Meta-bundle: the whole idea-to-shipped pipeline in one install — the core-suite baseline (candor, code-review, git-workflow, hindsight, secret-scanning, skill-router, stack-scan) plus taskmaster clarification and cards, task-runner execution with delegation contracts, approaches deliberation, code-architecture plan-before-code and verification, testing, debugging, and the ui-ux and security lanes the cards dispatch into. Replaces taskmaster-suite, process-suite and quality-principles-suite (2026-09-14). Fifteen members: over the host's 200k skill-listing floor by design — the README names the settings line. Uninstall cleanly with /workflow-suite:uninstall.

plugins.name: craft-suite
plugins.description: Meta-bundle: the creative-build studio in one install — concept-first creative direction with a tiered motion catalog and WebGL/Three.js effects (craft-layer); browser design sessions, visual decisions rendered with the project's own components in any UI library, and live component-registry MCP sourcing (design-studio); plus the companion the studio requires: ui-ux, which carries the WCAG audit. Split out of frontend-suite so ordinary frontend app work does not pay the studio's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /craft-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins. 200k-window installs: see the README's context-window requirement first.

plugins.name: skill-router
plugins.description: File-aware skill auto-routing: a PostToolUse hook injects one additionalContext directive to load the relevant best-practice skill(s) when you edit a matching file (PHP/Laravel/Blade, React/Vue/Inertia/Livewire via .tsx/.jsx/.vue, plain .ts/.js/.py/.go/.rb/.rs, SQL and migrations with engine-aware MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL rows, components, tests, Dockerfiles, OpenAPI), a SessionStart hook primes a repo-tailored skill index, and low-confidence content signals flush as one digest on your next prompt (SessionEnd keeps the ledger). Every relevant skill co-fires per edit; fail-open, once per skill per session.

plugins.name: command-guard
plugins.description: Destructive-command prevention: a PreToolUse hook that classifies every Bash (and MCP shell/SQL) command before it runs — denying irreversible data loss (migrate:fresh, db:wipe, DROP DATABASE, rm -rf /, git clean -fdx, docker compose down -v, terraform destroy, cloud deletes) and prompting on scoped-but-destructive ones (git reset --hard, rm -rf ./dir, kubectl delete pod). Reads through quotes, wrappers and heredocs; skips read-only commands; fail-open. Ships /command-guard:check and a user-owned allow-file the agent cannot edit.

plugins.name: secret-scanning
plugins.description: Secret-leak prevention: a PreToolUse hook that blocks a Write/Edit introducing a high-confidence secret (cloud keys, private-key blocks, provider tokens, assigned secret literals) before it reaches disk, plus a /secret-scanning:scan command to sweep a path or diff on demand. Fail-open, high-confidence-only, with a fixture escape.

plugins.name: ultra-deep-research
plugins.description: Deep-research harness that fans out parallel web searches, tiers sources by provenance, extracts date-stamped claims, and adversarially refutes them before synthesizing a cited report with a contradiction ledger and per-section confidence. Trigger 'ultra-deep-research' escalates to a Workflow-driven loop-until-dry fan-out with multi-vote refutation panels; standard depth runs a portable parallel-Agent fan-out. Ships /ultra-deep-research:research plus researcher and verifier subagents. Writes the report inline and to research/<topic>-<date>.md.
